evidence_passage: In lost-wax casting, a wax model is covered with a heat-resistant investment to form a mold. Heating the mold removes the wax and leaves a cavity in its place. Molten metal is poured into the cavity, and after the metal cools, the mold is broken away to reveal the cast object.
technique_question: Which technique uses a wax model that is removed from a mold before molten metal is poured into the resulting cavity?
source_webpage_text:
Lost-wax casting

In lost-wax casting, a wax model is covered with a heat-resistant investment to form a mold. Heating the mold removes the wax and leaves a cavity in its place. Molten metal is poured into the cavity, and after the metal cools, the mold is broken away to reveal the cast object. The method can reproduce complex forms and surface details.
